2390-6191-7816.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-6191-7816.description:
Gain life.
Titanbones triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1322-4770-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3169-3249-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3169-3249-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2074-6972-8095.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

225-3129-4365-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2104-4863-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Revolutionist.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Revolutionist from exile to the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

567-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
567-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

215-5614-6965.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-5614-6965.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

360-1274-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-1274-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

1169-3259-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
1169-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1687-2511-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-2907-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-2907-6157.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2615-4475.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a higher life total than Tree of Perdition's toughness.
2615-4475.description:
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, causing its toughness to become equal to an opponents life total, and causing that opponent to lose life equal to the difference between their life total and Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
2615-4475.notes: If the opponent's life total was at least double Tree of Perdition's toughness as the ability resolved, they will lose the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.

2060-2700-2744-4499-6774.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1651-1770-3875-6756-6850.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-3875-6756-6850.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-3875-6756-6850.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1170-1329-2478-4885.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1778-2099-5220-6900.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1062-5435-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-5435-5674-5870.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

560-2457-2837-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate the Cats by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

116-283-6558.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Naga Fleshcrafter.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Naga Fleshcrafter and another permanent you control.
Activate Naga Fleshcrafter by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1846-2930-4222.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Portent Tracker.
Portent Tracker does not have summoning sickness.
1846-2930-4222.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Portent Tracker.

165-1069-1251-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-1251-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

803-4231-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure, Food and Clue token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4067-4435-5611.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
4067-4435-5611.description:
Activate a Sliver by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the Sliver.
Repeat.

1024-5364.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one land.
You control at least one creature.
1024-5364.description: Cast Coalition Victory by paying {3}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to win the game.

536-1061-2726.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each other turn
536-1061-2726.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing and/or control at least eight permanents.
"Human", "Pirate", or "Wizard" chosen with Reflections of Littjara.
536-1061-2726.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Timestream Navigator spell.
Resolve the copy of the Timestream Navigator spell.
If you don't have the city's blessing and control ten or more permanents, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
Resolve the original Timestream Navigator spell.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Riptide Laboratory's second ability by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator to your hand from the battlefield.
During your next turn, repeat steps 1 through 7 one additional time.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 8 each turn.

2932-3054-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
2932-3054-4871-5256.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {B} due to Bontu's Monument.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Oathsworn Vampire's power.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

539-2232-2374-3661.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, Maja triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Shield Sphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

905-2178-2429-2713.notablePrerequisites: Zirda does not have summoning sickness.
905-2178-2429-2713.description:
Activate Zirda by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability and Zirda trigger.
Resolve the Revel in Riches trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Zirda trigger, untapping it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

844-1789-2232-4050.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Lathliss.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
The Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

250-779-4444.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
